creativeDirection: Use daylight location photography to stage a crisp, surreal editorial scene on a real open landscape, letting the graphic motifs become physically built objects while the two photographic portraits remain intact and clearly legible.
scene: A wide 16:9 view across a bright white salt flat edged by distant rocky mountains under a clear blue sky, shot from a slightly low eye level so the foreground objects feel large and sculptural. A field of oversized white keyboard keys stretches diagonally across the ground like a sparse walkway. Near the center sits an open wooden crate large enough to contain a person, beside a freestanding vintage microphone stand and several oversized glossy sculptural forms.

elements.element: the black-sunglasses motif becomes a large pop-colored billboard face panel planted upright in the salt flat, showing the close-up person from reference image 1 with the same framing, sunglasses, purple lips, black hair, reddish collar, and split blue-green background
the deep blue-violet glossy blob becomes a large smooth physical sculpture resting on the ground at a diagonal
the bright pink glossy blob becomes a second large smooth physical sculpture, offset from the blue form for color balance
the thin black line drawing of two embracing figures is painted minimally on one oversized white keyboard key in the foreground

the green striped oval with bird silhouettes becomes a circular-oval sign or disc mounted upright in the midground, with the pale moon-like disc and subtle retro graphic striping incorporated on its face

the woman from reference image 6 appears once, posed exactly as on the cover with long dark hair, chin resting on one hand, holding the large vintage microphone toward camera, placed beside the microphone stand and kept sharply visible

the barefoot woman from reference image 7 appears once inside the small wooden box/crate in her same crouching pose, long curly red hair, blue outfit, hands braced against the sides, with the small blue object beside her
the overall location borrows the mountain meadow intervention idea by translating it into a salt-flat landscape with oversized keyboard keys receding into the distance toward the mountains

coverSummaries.description: A minimal white cover with a thin black line drawing of two simplified human figures embracing in the center. The figures are outlined only, with no fill, and the composition is sparse with large empty space around them.

coverSummaries.signatureMotif: oversized computer keyboard keys placed in a mountain meadow

prompt: Wide 16:9 daylight view across a bright white salt flat with distant rocky mountains and a clear blue sky, shot from slightly low eye level so the foreground feels sculptural and expansive; the primary subject is a surreal listening station built into the landscape, with the woman from reference image 6 posed exactly as in her cover beside a freestanding vintage microphone stand, resting her face on one hand and holding the large vintage microphone toward the camera, her face sharp and fully visible. Nearby, the woman from reference image 7 appears once inside a small open wooden box placed on the salt flat, barefoot, crouching in the same braced pose with long curly red hair and blue outfit, the small blue object beside her inside the box. Plant upright in the midground a large pop-art face panel carrying the person from reference image 1 exactly as framed on the sleeve, with black sunglasses, black hair, purple lips, reddish collar, white shirt, and the split blue-green background. Scatter oversized white keyboard keys across the ground in receding rows inspired by reference image 8, with one prominent foreground key marked by the thin black line drawing of the embracing figures from reference image 4. Place a large deep blue-violet glossy blob sculpture from reference image 2 and a large bright pink glossy blob sculpture from reference image 3 on the salt surface as smooth physical objects. Include an upright retro sign based on reference image 5: a green striped oval face with black bird silhouettes and a pale circular disc motif. Daylight location photography, crisp editorial realism, physically plausible built installation in a real open landscape, no collage look. Strong clear composition with the microphone woman and box woman as human anchors, keyboard keys leading the eye into depth, billboard face and oval sign balancing the horizon. Hard midday sun with sharp shadows, clean air, high clarity, saturated colors, bright white ground, playful surreal mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one person shown in close-up wearing sunglasses; reference image 6 shows one woman with long dark hair holding a microphone and resting her chin on her hand; reference image 7 shows one barefoot woman with long curly hair crouching inside a box. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
